title: Reading Input from an USB RFID Card Reader
description: RFID technology has gained traction across various sectors, from inventory management to secure access control, as highlighted by a recent project involving a USB RFID card reader. This device not only scans cards but can also be integrated into applications, showcasing its versatility. By employing Golang for low-level hardware interactions, developers can harness the full potential of RFID readers, opening the door to innovative solutions.
